limitations.note: The rewrite stopped idle cycles from advancing the state, but it also replaced the original three-input, two-output packing sequence with one output per pair, dropping the output that combines the previous byte’s low nibble with the third byte.
The test exercised the third valid input but expected no output, so it passed by treating the missing second packed word as correct.
